paragraphs: Mentioned in Yoma 21a. (And it is a place name, as in Sanhedrin 63b: "Ulla stayed in Kalbeno"; and so Rashi explained in Zevachim 96a.)[^1]

notes.text: כא./סג:/צו. give Yoma 21a/Sanhedrin 63b/Zevachim 96a by convention. Hyman identifies Kalbeno as a place-name and נח as stayed/rested, not permanent dwelling or death. The preserved prior Davidson observation reports קלנבו (Kalnevo) and בת (lodged), versus Hyman’s קלבנו/נח; no fresh check of that passage or Rashi is claimed. Both source forms are retained without modern geographic binding. Shemaya’s full רב stays Rav; Ulla has no separate title and Rashi is a commentator label, not title evidence for Shemaya.
